caption: The drawing is divided into four equal square sections with additional diagonal divisions within the top right and bottom left squares, creating a total of six triangular or square subsections. In the top left section, there is a stylized bird with a green head, red and orange beak, red body, pink-striped underbelly, yellow details, black and yellow legs and feet, a green patch on the wing, and a pink, circular, patterned tail, standing on a patch of green and a pink-and-red platform. The top right section is diagonally divided; the bottom left half features a green background with a grid of black lines, while the upper right half contains a beige background with brown and light brown floral patterns. The lower left section is also diagonally divided; the upper right half has a peach background with a red and yellow plaid pattern, and the lower left half has a white background with a blue, red, and brown floral design. The bottom right square contains a potted plant with green leaves and two pink flowers, one rounded and one more spiky, in a decorated pot featuring yellows, browns, and reds, and also has a white background with faint curving lines. The background overall is white, and the drawing is signed "Ruth M. Barnes" at the bottom right.
title: Applique Quilt
